summary: Comprehensive test suite covering all main requirements (classification, reporting, multiple formats, strict mode, error handling) and most important edge cases. Tests are well-organized with clear fixtures and helpers. Includes both unit tests (rotation.bats) and workflow integration tests (workflow.bats + act harness). Main gaps: UTC timezone handling verification is mentioned in script comments but not explicitly tested; some advanced edge cases untested (duplicate secret names, overflow values, unicode in JSON, file permission errors); external tool dependencies (jq, python3, actionlint, act) not validated during setup, which could cause cryptic failures in unfamiliar environments. Act harness is thorough but complex—trap cleanup could fail if interrupted. Overall, this would effectively catch most regressions in core functionality, but edge case coverage and test robustness could be strengthened.
